claim_limit: This frozen record documents first-party institutional code corroboration from the PerForm-Lab-RIT Pupil-Labs-Core-RITnet-Plugins repository. The reviewed GIW extraction script identifies four extracted task directories (Indoor_Walk, Ball_Catch, Visual_Search, Tea_Making), loads ProcessData files from each task directory, reads PrIdx and TrIdx from each ProcessData object, and uses PrIdx/TrIdx to address the raw Gaze-in-the-Wild recording tree. The script does not directly enumerate a numeric TrIdx-to-task lookup and does not explicitly bind TrIdx 4 to Tea_Making. Therefore authoritative complete file-level task mapping, task-stratified validation, cross-dataset claims, native-60-Hz/GP3 validity, acquisition-hardware cadence verification, quarantine exit, and new empirical-performance claims remain unauthorized.

first_party_structural_corroboration.interpretation: The source verifies first-party task-separated extraction structure and that each task directory's ProcessData records carry PrIdx/TrIdx identities. It does not itself publish the per-file numeric TrIdx-to-task lookup needed to authorize task labels.
